THE OPENAI ROWS BELOW ARE UNCONFIRMED — they were added on 2026-08-18 when trip-agent moved onto gpt-5-mini, from OpenAI's published per-million rates, but nobody has checked them against the account's own billing page yet. They are here rather than absent because an unpriced model meters at zero, which silently disables every client's daily budget cap on it — a wrong-by-a-little number that still enforces a cap beats an honest gap that enforces nothing. Verify them and delete this sentence.
